## Summary
Staff-level engineer building products people actually use — from the screen they touch to the services that keep it running. Over a decade of experience shipping 0-to-1 across startups and enterprises, owning the stack from product design to observable infrastructure. Recent focus: applied AI and reliable agentic systems at scale.
